'''Sliteye's Entertainment Emporium''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|bar]] located on the outskirts of the [[Ord Mynock Freeport]]. It had a glitzy and gaudy facade, but the interior was designed to cater to workers and [[Miner/Legends|miners]]. The Emporium was owned by [[Zelto Sliteye]], and he allowed criminals to use the location as a base of operations. [[Vasteg]] the [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Forger (profession)/Legends|forger]] and [[Jnoofot]] the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] ran their operations out of the Emporium.<ref name="Game" />
